extDescription.message: Smoother 4K playback on web bilibili for Taiwan/Singapore users. Unofficial, not affiliated with bilibili.

autoFallbackHint.message: When a video or live stream freezes or a route can't connect, automatically switch to another working route so you aren't stuck on a spinner. If your own connection is unstable (e.g. weak Wi-Fi), it may keep switching and blank the picture while reloading — turn it off in that case.

customHostPlaceholder.message: Enter a CDN host, e.g. upos-sz-mirrorxxx.bilivideo.com

customHintDefault.message: Host only (domain), no http:// or path.

customHintInvalid.message: Please enter a valid host (with domain, e.g. xxx.bilivideo.com).

feedbackBtnLabel.message: 🐛 Report a bug / Request a feature

debugInitial.message: No data yet. Open a bilibili video page.

debugNoDataAfterOpen.message: No data yet. Open this popup after playback starts on a bilibili video page.

stHintLeave.message: Tests each node using segments from the current video and quality; leaving this page stops the test immediately.

stHintBandwidth.message: This measures each node's theoretical maximum bandwidth, not the actual speed used during playback — playback may not need this much bandwidth, so a higher number here than in the debug overlay is normal.

speedtestNoSampleHint.message: Start playback on a bilibili video page first to get a segment sample before testing.

speedtestCannotStart.message: Could not start the speed test. Make sure the current tab is a bilibili video page.

cdnNoteSecondBest2.message: Huawei Cloud Hybrid CDN, TW/SG 2nd-best route

cdnNoteSecondBest3.message: Huawei Cloud Hybrid CDN, TW/SG 3rd-best route

mhToastAutoSwitched.message: Current CDN is slow, automatically switched to backup node {host}

mhToastAllFailed.message: Neither the current CDN nor the backup node can play smoothly

mhToastReloadBackup.message: Reload and switch to Backup URL

modeOffHintVideo.message: Does not touch CDN selection for regular videos; Bilibili's original behavior is kept.

modeOffHintLive.message: Does not touch CDN selection for live streams; Bilibili's original behavior is kept.

stLiveHintLeave.message: Tests each route with the stream of the current live room; leaving this page stops the test immediately.

stLiveHintBandwidth.message: The test competes for bandwidth with the live stream you are watching, so the picture may stutter briefly. Each route takes about {sec} seconds.

liveSpeedtestNoSampleHint.message: Start playing a Bilibili live room first so the stream URL is known, then run the test.

liveSpeedtestCannotStart.message: Cannot start the test. Make sure the current tab is a Bilibili live room.

liveSpeedtestUnavailableHint.message: None of the routes could be reached. Refresh the live room and try again.

mhToastLiveFallback.message: Live route is poor; switched to International (ov)

liveRouteExplain.message: Live streams can't switch freely between nodes like videos can: each time you enter a live room, Bilibili assigns you its own set of nodes, and any other set won't play. So what you pick here is a preferred route type, and the extension switches to that route within the set Bilibili gave you.

showDebugHint.message: Shows technical info such as the route actually in use at the top-left of the player, and lists the same info below. Only needed when reporting a problem or comparing speeds.

staleTabText.message: The extension was just updated or reloaded; refresh the tab for it to take effect.

videoFallbackHint.message: With "Auto-switch on failure" on, playback switches back to Bilibili's official node automatically when this node fails.

sortBySpeedHint.message: When on, each node slides into place (fastest first) as soon as its speed test finishes. The order is remembered and the node lists use it too, until you run the test again. Works for both video and live; turning it off restores the default order.

stVideoLimitHint.message: Each node is tested until it has downloaded this much or this many seconds have passed, whichever comes first. Bigger numbers give more accurate results but the test takes longer.

stLiveLimitHint.message: "Switch lag" is measured several times and averaged; "Keeping up" actually pulls the stream on each route for a few seconds to see whether it keeps pace. More runs or seconds give more accurate results but the test takes longer.
